content: Passing a raw file:// Uri via ACTION_SEND EXTRA_STREAM throws FileUriExposedException on Android 7.0+ (API 24+). Correct approach is to obtain a content:// Uri (via FileProvider, or in this project's case directly via the MediaStore insert Uri) and call intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION) so the receiving app (WhatsApp) can read it without a crash or SecurityException.
